title: Kionga pipeline step report
description: Body of POST /api/v1/pipelines/runs/{id}/steps, sent by the executing pipeline at every step transition. Open contract (see docs/compatibility.md): the gateway accepts and ignores properties it does not know, so a newer producer never fails against an older gateway.

step.description: Node ID of the step in the pipeline definition.

message.description: Free text. The gateway logs the last line of a non-success message.

attempt.description: Attempt number of this transition; 0 or absent when unknown.

workload_kind.description: Where the step ran, for example docker or k8s-pod.

at.description: When the transition happened, RFC 3339 UTC.
